Editor.problem: New, and it decides whether the title is true. The reproduce.sh gate (prom_total > 1.5 × want, otherwise 'nothing to fix') and the takeaway ('reaches Splunk once per agent') both assume Splunk keeps two series per pod in the everywhere runs. Two agents scraping the same pod produce the same instance, service.instance.id, job and run label. If the custom metrics/orders pipeline doesn't pass through a processor that adds the scraping agent's identity (host.name or k8s.node.name from resourcedetection), the two agents write to one MTS. Splunk then reads about 1×, not 2×, and the paid reproduce run fails on the gate even with pod_scrapers = 4. check.sh writes to a file, so this free rehearsal cannot catch it.
Editor.fix: Print the metrics/orders pipeline's processor list from config-everywhere.yaml and state which dimension is expected to differ between agents. In reproduce.sh, gate only on pod_scrapers = 4 and on otel_total matching. Record prom_total and prom_series with op present and don't fail on them. Do the same for the everywhere case in fix.sh. Make the title and takeaway conditional: 'once per agent' only if splunk_series_per_pod_max = 2 and a splitting dimension is named. If the series merge into one, the result is a different article: duplicates that hide in one MTS.

Editor.problem: Earlier point 3 is still partly open. set_config now saves the whole relay config and fails per config, which is good. But nothing prints K8S_NODE_NAME as resolved on each agent pod. agent_map shows only spec.nodeName, so an empty ${env:K8S_NODE_NAME}, which turns the selector into 'spec.nodeName=', can't be told apart from a real result. The autodetect check also requires the literal 'prometheus/autodetect:'. If chart 0.163.1 names the receiver_creator entry differently (for example prometheus_simple), the autodetect runs fail at set_config and the paid run is lost.
Editor.fix: In set_config, for each agent pod print `kubectl -n splunk exec <agent> -- printenv K8S_NODE_NAME` next to its spec.nodeName, and fail if either is empty or they differ. For autodetect, check for `receiver_creator` plus the rule containing `prometheus.io/scrape` instead of a fixed receiver name, and print the whole rule block without `head` truncation or 2>/dev/null.

Editor.problem: Earlier points 1 and 2 have artifact gaps. Name detection, the service.instance.id grouping and the PROMETHEUS_DISABLE_CREATED_SERIES env are fixed. But the visible splunk_run neither writes metric-names-<run>.txt (each orders_created* sf_metric with its series count) nor series-<run>.json ($got). Without them the article can't show which metric name Splunk holds or the full dimension set behind splunk_dims_splitting_a_pod. Also, dims_n defaults to 0 when unset, so a failed jq would report '0 dimensions' as if it were a finding.
Editor.fix: In splunk_run, write `$names` plus per-name series counts to metric-names-<run>.txt and `$got` to series-<run>.json for all six runs. Set dims_n explicitly from the jq result, and emit 'error' rather than 0 when jq fails or got = '{}'.
